gap: No result ChatGPT got states, side by side, which chargers have a maker page today that says 100 W + 100 W and what each costs in stock: on 2026-11-13 the Anker Prime 200W (A2683) was in stock at $69.99 on anker.com, which says each of two USB-C ports gives up to 100 W; Satechi's ChargeView 240W table lists 100 W + 100 W only on C2+C3, C2+C4 and C3+C4; and the Anker Prime 250W ($149.99) and GEARit 240W ($84.88) pages list only 140 W + 100 W or a 240 W two-port total, never 100 W + 100 W.
standout_why: I checked against the pages ChatGPT cited: anker.com A2683 and A2345, Satechi's ChargeView power-distribution page, the Satechi 200W manual, UGREEN's 4-port page and Best Buy, plus computingforgeeks.com/best-gan-charger-laptop, a top result. ChatGPT already gave $69.99 for the A2683, $149.99 for the A2345 and the 140+100 split for the ChargeView. Computingforgeeks says Anker publishes no per-combination table for the 250W, but it gives only price ranges ('roughly $70 to $80') and tested nothing. None of them puts the documented 100+100 models next to today's in-stock maker prices. None says the ChargeView's 100+100 needs a C2/C3/C4 pair. None says the GEARit page lists no output for C3. Our own page is also out of date: it says the A2683 was sold out on 2026-11-03, but it is in stock today.
decides: This backs the Anker Prime 200W (A2683) as the pick. Of the chargers I could price today, it is the cheapest one whose maker page says 100 W + 100 W, and anker.com shows it in stock at $69.99. Our row must change from 'Sold out' to $69.99, in stock, 2026-11-13. The Anker Prime 250W costs $80 more, and its page never lists 100 W + 100 W, only up to 240 W for two ports with a note that output may vary by firmware. The GEARit 240W page only promises 140 W on C1 plus 100 W on C2. The Satechi ChargeView 240W does document 100 W + 100 W, but only on C2/C3/C4 pairs, and I couldn't get a price for it today. The UGREEN 4-port's $61.99 could undercut the Anker, but I couldn't re-check it today, so it shouldn't lead on price until someone does.
